normal.text: Obscure is an old PS2 horror game that's a little wonky but fun. It got a steam rerelease a long time ago. The original clock tower for SNES is also a blast to play. heated.name: Crux 🦇
heated.text: Hey it is a terrifying era to be a video game industry employee right now. Nobody is safe. My childhood dream has been achieved at the worst time possible. If you have gamedev friends, reach out. We are all at an all-time low, whether it be because of AI rotting our craft, layoffs or closures.
